'''2012 European Championship Dan Price DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Price]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
